---
name: medical-visual-mini
description: Inspect a host-bound medical image through a bounded visual tool and record observations without inventing image findings.
---

# Medical visual inspection

1. Request only the current host-provided image identifier and an allowed
   focus such as quality, anatomy, finding, comparison, or measurement.
2. Record observed image evidence separately from a differential or
   uncertainty. Request another permitted view only when it resolves a stated
   gap.
3. Keep image-derived statements within the declared research or simulation
   objective. Do not claim an unseen image, a real examination, or a diagnosis.
4. Pass image observations through the declared artifact validator before
   delivery.
